title: My CVs
intro: Keep up to {{max}} CV variants, and mark the one you apply with by default as primary.

create.disabledReason: You already have {{max}} active variants, the maximum. Archive one before creating another.

archive.title: Archive this CV variant?
archive.body: The variant stops being available for applications. Every version you uploaded to it is kept, and you can create another variant as long as you have fewer than {{max}} active ones.
archive.lastActiveReason: This is your only active variant, so it cannot be archived.

versions.title: Uploaded versions
versions.scanPending: This version is being scanned. It becomes downloadable once the scan clears it.
versions.scanPollingHint: This list refreshes on its own while a scan is running.
versions.emptyHint: Upload a PDF or Word document to add the first version.

upload.hint: PDF or Word document, up to {{max}} bytes.
upload.scanPending: The file was accepted and is being scanned for malware. It becomes downloadable once the scan clears it.
upload.failedTitle: This file could not be uploaded
upload.unsupportedMediaType: Choose a PDF or a Word (.docx) document.

download.failedTitle: This version could not be downloaded
download.incomplete: The transfer stopped before the whole file arrived, so the partial file was discarded. Try the download again.

blocked.pending_scan: The scan has not finished yet, so this version cannot be downloaded.
blocked.quarantined: The scan quarantined this version, so it cannot be downloaded.
blocked.unknown_state: This version is not available for download.

admin.title: CV variants and versions
admin.noVersions: No versions have been uploaded to this variant.

detail.notFoundTitle: This CV variant was not found
detail.notFound: It may have been removed, or the address may be wrong. Go back to your CVs and choose one from the list.

announce.updated: The changes to the CV variant were saved.
announce.primary: This CV variant is now your primary one.
announce.uploadAccepted: The file was accepted and is being scanned.
announce.uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded.
